posts.raw_content:
This is ultimately why conservatism keeps losing... Conservatives refuse to play dirty.

No nation or ideology has ever won any conflict by playing fair. Did the British colonize Africa by having their troops lay down their guns and fight the Zulus with spears instead? Did America win WW2 by launching an infantry invasion of Japan? Did liberalism itself win the culture war back in the 1970s by playing fair?

No... no one in history wins by playing fair. You win by playing smart, not by playing fair. The liberals set up a system where everybody in the country is required to be an environment where they are ideologically indoctrinated into liberal/progressive values for 17 years in order to be economically successful. Then when the kids go back home, their music, their TV shows, their movies... Promote the same message. All their peers are liberal, their favorite celebrities are all liberal, their teachers are liberal, their favorite characters in movies are liberal. The government promotes liberalism.

What are their conservative influences? Their parents... Maybe? Even that's not the default anymore. Tons of kids are born into single mother households, or to liberal/progressive parents, or to nutty, paranoid conservative parents who are too strict and make their kids hate them. The church is still conservative in most areas, but only 30-50% of the population is affected by the church still and the church alone cannot change people's minds.

Notice how liberals have set the following rules... Conservatives are not allowed to use the education system, the government, or the media/entertainment industry to promote their ideology or else liberals and weak/soft conservatives will accuse them of authoritarianism or "being just like the left!" Conservatives are therefore restricted to only using parents and the church as their vectors of influence.

Meanwhile, liberals freely promote liberal values through every institution they can find. Not only that, but many conservatives don't raise an objection to it because its become so normalized that even conservative people enforce tolerance of liberal propaganda. If I complain for example that a movie or song is promoting liberal immorality... People will criticize me and say "just watch the movie!" But if a movie contains conservative messages, the same people will turn around and say "I don't like conservatives putting their ideology in movies anymore then I like it when leftists do it." But in practice, they tolerate it when liberal values are promoted in media by shaming anyone who objects to it, while simultaneously shaming conservatives for promoting conservatives values through their movies/music.

This is not just a problem with actual liberals by the way. This is a consistent problem I find with center-right type conservatives who will say they want a conservative society while simultaneously being opposed to every method we could possibly use to get that conservative society.

Conservatives have got to learn to play smart and ruthlessly. We need to actually want to win and stop fighting this culture war with the belief that liberals winning is an acceptable outcome. We need to use every method, every tool, and every strategy we can think of to win even if that includes using unconventional or Machiavellian tactics.
